repos_data.description: ✨ Finder Toolbar app for macOS to open the current directory in Terminal, iTerm, Hyper or Alacritty.
📂 macOS Finder toolbar app to open current folder in Visual Studio Code
This is a app for macOS that to open a new Finder window and change the current directory to the folder this app launched.
A ZSH plugin to allow easy named directory creation - shortcuts to any directory you want
